newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MRCB to buy 19.05 pct of Rashid Hussain.
newsitem.headline: MRCB to buy 19.05 pct of Rashid Hussain.

text.p: Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) said on Wednesday that it has signed an agreement to buy 19.05 percent of Rashid Hussain Bhd for 1.04 billion ringgit, the national Bernama news agency reported.
The deal is for 66.127 million Rashid shares at 15.80 ringgit each to be satisfied by the issuance of 130.6 million new shares in MRCB at 8.00 ringgit per share.

MRCB, a divesified firm, said that it has to date acquired 3.5 million shares in the financial services and property concern from the open market for 52.8 million ringgit in cash or 15 ringgit per share.
Together, MRCB will hold a total of 69.63 million Rashid shares or 20.06 percent equity interest in the company, which owns the largest institutional stockbrokerage in Malaysia.
Rashid Hussain is presently in talks to buy a 75 percent interest in Kwong Yik Bank Bhd from Malayan Banking Bhd.

MRCB said the proposed Rashid Hussain acquisition would allow it to diversify its earnings base. The proposal will increase its paid-up and issued capital to 649.2 million shares from 518.57 million shares as at October 30, 1996, it said.
The proposed Rashid acquisition is expected to be completed by June 30, 1997 and is not expected to have any material impact on its consolidated earnings for the year ending August 31, 1997.
MRCB stock closed at 9.70 ringgit on October 22. It has been suspended pending the news announcement.
